recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is for FHIR-16440. Any future CodeSystem wording or DesignationUse content changes should proceed under a dedicated final tracker rather than being inferred from this ValueSet-only issue.
issue_request: FHIR-16440 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification vocabulary change request for ValueSet.compose.include.concept.designation.use. It asked to replace wording that described the element as detailing how a designation would be used with wording that treats the Coding as a type of designation use; the final resolution specified short/description text "Types of uses of designations" and definition "A code that represents types of uses of designations."
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in commit ed1b1c861d8114e8ab4df64b138283d22a12eeed, "GF#16440 - improve definition of ValueSet.compose.include.concept.designation.use," which changed source/valueset/valueset-spreadsheet.xml to the resolved short and definition. Later source refactors moved the current authoritative text to source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml, where the same wording remains.
additional_context: ValueSet is an active resource in source/fhir.ini and assigned to the vocab work group, so the inspected ValueSet StructureDefinition source is in current build scope. The parallel CodeSystem.concept.designation.use wording still uses the older "details how" phrasing, but FHIR-16440's related artifact and historical application targeted ValueSet only. Later designation-use issues found during the bounded search either concern additionalUse or value set contents, and FHIR-57375 remains Submitted rather than final. Community searches found broader designation-use discussion but no reversal or current-source requirement for this seed wording.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active current source already matches the published Jira resolution exactly, and broadening the change to CodeSystem would overreach the seed and lack a final related decision.
